blocks.en: In this section, we shall consider evolution problems of the form\[u_t=A(t)u,\]where $u$ depends on $t\in[0,T]$ and $\bm{x}\in\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, and $A(t)$ is some elliptic differential operator. We shall formulate such problems as abstract evolution problems in a Hilbert space, such as $L^2(\Omega)$. In order to do so, we must first introduce spaces of functions whose values are in a Banach space.
blocks.zh: 本节考虑如下形式的演化问题\[u_t=A(t)u,\]其中 $u$ 依赖于 $t\in[0,T]$ 和 $\bm{x}\in\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, 而 $A(t)$ 为某个椭圆微分算子. 将把此类问题表述为 Hilbert 空间 (例如 $L^2(\Omega)$) 中的抽象演化问题. 为此, 必须先引入取值于 Banach 空间的函数空间.

blocks.en: Banach Space Valued Functions and Distributions
blocks.zh: Banach 空间值函数与分布
blocks.label: subsec:banach-valued-functions-distributions

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: What we have in mind here is letting functions of both space and time,\[\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{R}^n\supset I\times\Omega\ni(t,\bm{x})\mapsto u(t,\bm{x})\in\mathbb{R},\]be thought of as a collection of functions of space parameterized by time. For instance, the function described above might be of the form\[\mathbb{R}\supset I\in t\mapsto u(t,\cdot)\in L^2(\Omega).\]Note that a function in, say $C([0,1],L^2(\Omega))$ need not be continuous in $\bm{x}$. It needs only be true that any two ``snapshots\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ of the function at nearby times be close in $L^2(\Omega)$. For example, if $v\in L^2(\Omega)$ and $g\in C^n(I)$, then\[u(t,\bm{x}):=g(t)v(\bm{x})\]is in $C^n(I,L^2(\Omega))$ no matter how many discontinuities $v$ has.
blocks.zh: 这里的想法是将同时依赖于空间和时间的函数\[\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{R}^n\supset I\times\Omega\ni(t,\bm{x})\mapsto u(t,\bm{x})\in\mathbb{R},\]看作以时间为参数的一族空间函数. 例如, 上面描述的函数可以具有如下形式\[\mathbb{R}\supset I\in t\mapsto u(t,\cdot)\in L^2(\Omega).\]注意, 比如 $C([0,1],L^2(\Omega))$ 中的函数不必关于 $\bm{x}$ 连续. 只需该函数在相近时刻的任意两个 ``快照\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ 在 $L^2(\Omega)$ 中接近. 例如, 若 $v\in L^2(\Omega)$ 且 $g\in C^n(I)$, 则\[u(t,\bm{x}):=g(t)v(\bm{x})\]属于 $C^n(I,L^2(\Omega))$, 而不论 $v$ 有多少个不连续点.
blocks.label: ex:banach-valued-time-spatial-functions

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We now let $I$ be an open interval and define $\mathcal{D}(I,X)$ to be the space of all $C^\infty$-functions from $I$ to $X$ which have compact support in $I$. A notion of convergence in $\mathcal{D}(I,X)$ is defined analogously as in Chapter~\ref{chap:distributions}; i.e., a sequence converges if the supports are contained in a common compact subset of $I$ and all derivatives converge uniformly.\par Let $X^*$ be the dual space of $X$. Then we denote the set of continuous linear mappings from $\mathcal{D}(I,X)$ to the field of scalars (i.e., $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$) by $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(I,X^*)$. We refer to the elements of $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(I,X^*)$ as $X^*$-valued distributions. It is clear that $C(I,X^*)$ is contained in $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(I,X^*)$. Moreover, the definitions of distributional derivatives are easily extended to Banach space valued distributions.
blocks.zh: 现在设 $I$ 为开区间, 将 $\mathcal{D}(I,X)$ 定义为从 $I$ 到 $X$ 且在 $I$ 中具有紧支集的所有 $C^\infty$ 函数构成的空间. 与 Chapter~\ref{chap:distributions} 类似, 定义 $\mathcal{D}(I,X)$ 中的收敛概念; 即若某序列的支集都包含在 $I$ 的同一个紧子集中, 且各阶导数均一致收敛, 则称该序列收敛.\par 设 $X^*$ 为 $X$ 的对偶空间. 将从 $\mathcal{D}(I,X)$ 到标量域 (即 $\mathbb{R}$ 或 $\mathbb{C}$) 的连续线性映射的集合记为 $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(I,X^*)$. 将 $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(I,X^*)$ 的元素称为 $X^*$ 值分布. 显然, $C(I,X^*)$ 包含于 $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(I,X^*)$. 此外, 分布导数的定义很容易推广到 Banach 空间值分布.

blocks.en: Let $H$, $V$ and $A(t)$ be as above. Assume that the functions $f\in L^2((0,T),V^*)$ and $u_0\in H$ are given. Then \eqref{eq:abstract-parabolic-evolution-initial-value-problem} has a unique solution $u\in L^2((0,T),V)\cap H^1((0,T),V^*)$.
blocks.zh: 设 $H$, $V$ 和 $A(t)$ 如上. 假设给定函数 $f\in L^2((0,T),V^*)$ 和 $u_0\in H$. 则 \eqref{eq:abstract-parabolic-evolution-initial-value-problem} 有唯一解 $u\in L^2((0,T),V)\cap H^1((0,T),V^*)$.
blocks.label: thm:abstract-parabolic-existence-uniqueness

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In this result, the differential equation in \eqref{eq:abstract-parabolic-evolution-initial-value-problem} is of course interpreted in the sense of $V^*$-valued distributions. Moreover, by the Sobolev imbedding theorem, we have $u\in C([0,T],V^*)$, which allows us to interpret the initial condition. Indeed, we can say more.
blocks.zh: 在这个结果中, \eqref{eq:abstract-parabolic-evolution-initial-value-problem} 中的微分方程当然按 $V^*$ 值分布的意义理解. 此外, 由 Sobolev 嵌入定理, 有 $u\in C([0,T],V^*)$, 因而可以解释初始条件. 实际上, 还能得到更强的结论.

blocks.en: This shows that Theorem~\ref{thm:abstract-parabolic-existence-uniqueness} is optimal; i.e., if we want a solution with the regularity guaranteed by the theorem, then the assumptions which we made on $f$ and $u_0$ are necessary.\par We now prove the lemma.
blocks.zh: 这说明 Theorem~\ref{thm:abstract-parabolic-existence-uniqueness} 是最优的; 即若希望解具有该定理所保证的正则性, 则对 $f$ 和 $u_0$ 所作的假设是必要的.\par 现在证明该引理.

blocks.en: The realization that a priori estimates like \eqref{eq:abstract-parabolic-solution-apriori-bound} can indeed be used as a foundation of existence proofs rather than just uniqueness was one of the milestones in the modern theory of PDEs. We have already encountered this idea (in the form of Galerkin\textquotesingle s method) in the proof of the Browder-Minty theorem in Chapter~\ref{chap:nonlinear-elliptic-equations}. More generally, the technique proceeds as follows. One first constructs a family of approximate problems for which an a priori estimate analogous to \eqref{eq:abstract-parabolic-solution-apriori-bound} holds, but which are easily shown to have solutions. This yields a sequence of approximate solutions, for which one has uniform bounds. Uniform bounds imply the existence of a weakly convergent subsequence. One then shows that the weak limit is the solution we seek.
blocks.zh: 认识到像 \eqref{eq:abstract-parabolic-solution-apriori-bound} 这样的先验估计确实可以作为存在性证明而不仅仅是唯一性证明的基础, 是现代 PDE 理论的里程碑之一. 在 Chapter~\ref{chap:nonlinear-elliptic-equations} 的 Browder-Minty 定理的证明中, 已经遇到这一思想 (采用 Galerkin 方法的形式). 更一般地, 这一技巧按如下方式进行. 首先构造一族近似问题, 它们满足类似于 \eqref{eq:abstract-parabolic-solution-apriori-bound} 的先验估计, 且很容易证明有解. 这就得到一个具有一致界的近似解序列. 一致界蕴含弱收敛子序列的存在性. 再证明该弱极限就是所求的解.
